data.description: For enrollment, materializes and verifies only the request-bound initial whole bundle in the fixed helper-controlled root and returns EnrollmentPreparedV1 without launch. For activation, opens and reverifies candidate and preserved previous slots against baton, enrollment, capability, and journal identities; it never asks the slot manager to compile or mutate a published slot
data.technology: BuildSlotVerifyPortV1 with bounded artifacts and opened identity handles
